name: Trading terminal
purpose: Watch-only terminal fragment with a ticker, a symbol chart, and a working-order grid.
scenarios: Select a symbol to update the price chart
Inspect working orders for the selected symbol

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for bundled block copy.

onSelectSymbol.description: Called when a symbol action is activated.

variants.name: density
variants.description: Inherits density from token rungs rather than a local viewport query.

antiPatterns: Do not present this template as a live matching engine or order-entry path.
Do not size the layout with viewport width media queries.

keyboard: Tab reaches ticker, symbol actions, chart, and grid
a11y.focus: Symbol actions stay in document order with a visible focus ring.
a11y.labeling: Ticker, chart, grid, and symbol actions have accessible names.

responsive.strategy: Chart and grid stack; @container at 48rem places them side by side. No viewport media queries.

breakpoints.medium: Chart and grid sit in two columns at 48rem container inline-size.
breakpoints.large: Chart and grid remain in two columns.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction comes from locale language.
